mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.avatar, u.person_introduction as personIntroduction, u.article_count as articleCount, u.follower_count as followerCount, u.following_count as followingCount, uf.focus_time as focusTime, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_focus WHERE user_id = #{currentUserId} AND focus_user_id = u.user_id ) > 0 as isFollowing FROM user_focus uf LEFT JOIN user_info u ON uf.user_id = u.user_id WHERE uf.focus_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.focus_time DESC

select u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.avatar,u.person_introduction,u.article_count,u.follower_count,u.following_count,uf.focus_time from user_focus uf left join user_info u on u.user_id = uf.focus_user_id where uf.user_id = #{userId} order by uf.focus_time desc
